title: My Domain
tagline: One sentence explaining the logical space.
audience: Domain experts who should attack this experiment
description: Describe the space without forcing a hierarchy or fixed ontology.
challenge: State one unresolved question with multiple plausible explanations.
learning_target: State exactly what new held-out capability would count as learning.
explore_prompt: Tell the Logical Robot what domain to investigate and what distinctions matter.
notes: Prefer stronger falsification and better observations over a larger vocabulary.
